transcript: Lotta just launched 17 free AI certifications. If you paid for these anywhere else, it would easily cost you more than $5,000. Here are the three that I would start with first. First, to find these, go to anthropic.com/learn. Then, if you click on see all courses, it will bring you over to this page that has all of their 17 certifications. The first one I would learn is Claude 101, where it will break down all of the basics of Claude and get you your first certification. Second one I would focus on is introduction to model context protocol. That's how you attach MCPs, which will show you how you can connect other apps into Claude. And the third one I'd recommend looking into is introduction to agent skills, which will teach you how to create skills using Claude. Save this video and follow for more AI tips.
